articles.title: Lower Millrace Asks Council for Speed Limit Change
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Lilac Lane disagreed about cost and timing.
body: Residents of Lower Millrace said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.

Councilmember Mateo Tiernan asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $850. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.
Public works estimates the work will take about 36 weeks once it starts in June.

body: Born in Cedar Hollow in the years after the war, Mariana Wallace spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
